basic_details.short_information: SAMEER Recruitment 2026: Society for Applied Microwave Electronics Engineering and Research (SAMEER), an autonomous research organization under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India, has released for 140 contractual project positions at Mumbai and Navi Mumbai. The vacancies include Project Fellow, Project Scientist, Project Engineer, Project Associate, Project Scientific Assistant, Project Technical Assistant, Project Manager and Project Executive posts. Candidates with relevant Ph.D., M.Tech., B.E./B.Tech., M.Sc., MBA, Diploma, B.Sc., B.Com., B.A.

content_sections.heading: SAMEER Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must possess the post-specific qualification from a Government-recognized institution or university. The notification generally requires at least 55% marks or equivalent CGPA , with relevant post-qualification work experience where prescribed. The Ph.D. thesis specialization must match the eligible research areas described in the detailed job-description annexure. Important: An M.E./M.Tech. or relevant Ph.D. is required for these Scientist positions. Candidates cannot assume a B.E./B.Tech. degree alone meets the qualification requirement. The exact eligible degree combinations and specializations must match the respective post-code descriptions in the notification annexure. A minimum of 55% marks or equivalent CGPA is generally required. Yes. Project Engineer and Project Associate positions generally do not require previous experience. Candidates must still possess the relevant qualification and minimum marks. The notification also permits certain final-year candidates awaiting results to apply for Project Engineer/Associate posts where specifically allowed. Such candidates must produce proof of passing and meet the minimum qualification requirements before joining. These positions generally require three years of relevant experience . However, the annexure provides an alternative entry route without experience for candidates possessing a relevant M.E., M.Tech. or Ph.D. Applicants should verify the accepted advanced qualifications for their selected discipline rather than assuming any postgraduate degree qualifies for the exemption. The qualification must generally carry at least 55% marks. Required experience depends on whether the vacancy is for Level A, B or C. Candidates must possess ITI National Trade Certificate (NTC) and a valid National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) in the relevant notified trade. The notification requires at least 55% marks in ITI or equivalent CGPA and a valid NAC, with a combined ITI/apprenticeship duration of at least two years as prescribed. Important: An ITI certificate alone is insufficient for these Technical Assistant posts because the relevant NAC is also required. These positions generally require 55% marks or equivalent CGPA in the relevant qualifying education. A typing speed of 35 words per minute is mandatory for the Project Executive and Project Executive Assistant positions, as specified in the annexure.

content_sections.heading: SAMEER Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive consolidated monthly remuneration ranging from Rs. 21,000 to Rs. 55,000 , depending on their project category and grade. Salary Clarification: These figures represent consolidated contractual remuneration, not regular Government pay scales. SAMEER states that experience beyond the prescribed minimum does not automatically entitle a candidate to an additional increment.

content_sections.heading: SAMEER Contract Period and Employment Conditions
content_sections.text: The posts are temporary and project-specific. The notification expressly excludes any right to regularisation, permanent absorption, continued service or automatic contract extension. Selected candidates will normally work at Mumbai/Navi Mumbai but may be required to serve at another SAMEER centre or location in India, depending on project needs. Candidates previously engaged at any SAMEER centre as Research Scientist, Project Engineer or Project Associate for an aggregate period of five years or more are not eligible for appointment as Project Engineer or Project Associate under the notified restriction.

content_sections.heading: SAMEER Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection stages depend on the category of post. SAMEER may use academic screening, written examination, online interview, in-person interview or skill test as specified below. Where a written examination is prescribed, it may be conducted online as a computer-based test or in person. Candidates generally need at least 50% marks to qualify for the subsequent stage, subject to the prescribed shortlisting requirements. The written examination syllabus follows the general curriculum of Government-run universities and colleges for the relevant engineering, science, diploma, ITI or graduate qualification. The notification does not provide a common fixed question count, examination duration or negative-marking scheme for all posts. Where applicable, candidates may be shortlisted for online interviews in a ratio ordinarily of 1:6 or more against the advertised vacancies. For in-person interviews, the usual shortlisting ratio is 1:3 or more, as decided by the competent authority. Where no written examination is conducted, academic merit may be used for the next applicable stage. Final selection is based on in-person interview marks and/or skill test/interaction marks only , as applicable to the selected category. Written test and academic screening results are used for qualification or shortlisting and are not automatically added to the final merit score.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in SAMEER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Advertisement No. 10/2026 lists 140 indicative contractual project vacancies across scientific, engineering, technical and administrative positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for SAMEER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 15 November 2026 at 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q3. When did the SAMEER online application process start?
faq.answer: Applications opened on 4 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What qualifications are required for SAMEER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualifications vary by post and include relevant Ph.D., M.E./M.Tech., B.E./B.Tech., M.Sc., MBA, Bachelor's degree, Diploma or ITI with NTC and NAC.

faq.question: Q5. Can freshers apply for SAMEER Project Engineer posts?
faq.answer: Yes. Project Engineer posts generally permit candidates without previous experience, subject to the required degree and minimum marks.

faq.question: Q6. How many Project Engineer Electronics vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are 24 Project Engineer Electronics / EXTC / ECE vacancies under Post Code PE02.

faq.question: Q7. What is the upper age limit for SAMEER Project Engineer posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for Project Engineer and Project Associate posts is 28 years, before applicable relaxation.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for SAMEER Project Engineer posts?
faq.answer: Project Engineers and Project Associates receive consolidated remuneration of Rs. 34,000 per month.

faq.question: Q9. What is the highest monthly remuneration offered?
faq.answer: Project Fellow posts carry the highest advertised consolidated remuneration of Rs. 55,000 per month.

faq.question: Q10. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The PDF specifies Rs. 100, while the live recruitment portal displays nil for contractual posts. Candidates should verify the applicable amount on the advertisement-specific payment screen and check for official clarification.
